name: Signalpost Self-Hosted Status Page
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted status page and uptime monitor with HTTP, TCP, ping, DNS and heartbeat checks, incident and maintenance timelines, alerts, and SQLite storage; no vendor software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker host, persistent storage, backups and HTTPS; email, ntfy and other outbound alert services may have separate costs. Individual check results default to 14-day retention, with daily summaries kept longer. Set a strong admin password and protect the admin interface; no hosted monitoring infrastructure is included.
